messages:
lee: noticed a weird pattern this morning: SSE sessions in eu-west showing repeated 'probe' RTT spikes, then a batch of reconnects that land on the same overloaded pool. clients eventually give up. WS connections less affected.

Tess: can you paste a sample trace?

lee: snippet: ```
[2026-03-23T09:42:10Z] conn=0x9a keepalive sent
[2026-03-23T09:42:11Z] conn=0x9a probe rtt=980ms
[2026-03-23T09:42:11Z] conn=0x9a shepherd=trip backoff=2s
[2026-03-23T09:42:12Z] conn=0x9a reconnect route=eu-pool-11 util=93% sticky=true
```

maya: that's classic affinity amplification. if reconnects prefer same sticky pool we will hammer a hot node.

kai: two immediate mitigation ideas: 1) increase probe threshold in EU so transient tail latency doesn't trip shepherd, 2) allow one affinity-break reconnect attempt for probe-originated retries.

Tess: agree. visibility problem: probe events are sampled at 0.5% by default, so dashboards looked quiet and we missed the spike. we need an on-console toggle to raise probe sampling during incidents.

lee: yes — also quota and billing counts treat these reconnects as user disconnects which inflates reconnect-rate alerts and confuses support. can we add a disconnect_cause label (probe/user/idle) to the timeseries?

maya: adding disconnect_cause would let us filter alerts and keep billing sane. plus add a separate timeseries probe_reconnects_per_pool.

kai: implementation note: keep the relaxed-affinity behavior feature-flagged and gated behind rollout. I'd do 10% traffic first and watch probe_reconnects and pool utils. add small random jitter to backoff to prevent synchronized storms.

lee: proposed quick changes: bump eu shepherd_threshold_ms 500->800, add jitter +/-25% to backoff multiplier, feature flag relaxed_rejoin_affinity, console toggle probe_sampling, add disconnect_cause tag and probe_reconnects_per_pool metric.

Tess: rollout plan: 10% -> 33% -> 100% with 15m watch windows. patch dashboards and mute reconnect-rate pager for eu region during rollout. create adhoc panel showing probe vs user disconnects.

deploy-bot: rollout requested by lee. plan queued: 10% -> 33% -> 100%, watch 15m, telemetry bucket: sse.probe-mitigation-canary.

maya: UX ask: expose probe_sampling in Console with role gating (SRE+Oncall). we must avoid accidental 100% sampling from product.

kai: also add a console-side flag to mark 'probe' metrics as not billable for the first 30s after a probe event. that will avoid weird billing blips during noisy networks.

Tess: careful with billing exceptions; product/legal will need a short note. but we can mark for internal display first, then work with finance if we want to change invoicing.

lee: i'll open a single PR for the config + metric + flag + dashboard patch. will keep changes behind flags and add rollout docs. linking incident ticket in the PR.

maya: follow-up: long-term we should compare SSE vs WS failure modes in a weekly telemetry digest; seems SSE's long-lived connections expose different tail behaviors.

Tess: good idea. add a dashboard that correlates probe RTT percentiles, pool utilization, and reconnect success rate by protocol (sse/ws).

lee: thanks everyone. i'll kick off the canary after PR lands. :thumbsup:
